title: Read a document from AI Write
summary: Returns an AI Write document's title and text by its id or title. When no document matches, it lists the closest titles so the person can pick.
whenToUse: Use when the person refers to something they wrote or saved earlier ('my notes on…', 'the write-up from yesterday').

arguments.name: ref
arguments.description: The document's id, or words from its title

example: Open my notes on local language models and read me the main point
